name: Langfuse evaluation
description: Read the items of a Langfuse dataset and record experiment results and scores.

credential_code.label: Langfuse credential
credential_code.description: Empty = the Langfuse connection from the team settings.

dataset_name.label: Dataset name
dataset_name.description: Name of the dataset in Langfuse. A 'dataset_name' value in the flow input takes precedence.

dataset_version.label: Dataset version
dataset_version.description: Moment (ISO, for example 2026-10-27T07:52:00Z) at which the dataset is read. Empty = now. Pass the version from 'Get dataset items' on to 'Record experiment result' to store it on the experiment.

metadata_filter.label: Metadata filter
metadata_filter.description: JSON object: only items whose metadata has these values, for example {"split": "test"} or {"dossier": ["D01", "D03"]}. Empty = all active items. A 'metadata_filter' value in the flow input takes precedence.

include_content.label: Include input and expected output
include_content.description: Off = only id and metadata per item. Use it when a later step fetches each item separately, so the flow state stays small.

state_key_prefix.label: Prefix for input fields in the flow state
state_key_prefix.description: Also puts every field of the item input in the flow state as its own key, with this prefix. With 'eval_' the input field 'zaak' becomes the key 'eval_zaak'. Needed when a called agent reads its input from separate keys.

items.label: Items
items.description: The list the loop steps through, for example {{ dataset_ophalen.items }}. Each time the node runs it returns the next item; after the last one 'done' is true.

run_name.label: Run name
run_name.description: Name of the experiment in Langfuse. All items with the same run name form one experiment. For 'Get dataset items': empty = dataset name with date and time. A 'run_name' value in the flow input takes precedence.

run_metadata.label: Run metadata
run_metadata.description: JSON object stored with the experiment, for example the version of the agent and of the checks.

item.label: Dataset item
item.description: The item as this node returns it, for example {{ dataset_item_ophalen }}.

output.label: Output
output.description: What the solution returned for this item. It becomes the output of the trace in Langfuse.

scores.label: Scores
scores.description: List of {name, value, data_type, comment, metadata}. A true or false value becomes a boolean score, a number a numeric score.

started_at.label: Started at
started_at.description: Moment (ISO) at which work on this item started, for example {{ dataset_item_ophalen.fetched_at }}. Sets the duration Langfuse shows. Empty = now.

error_message.label: Error message
error_message.description: Fill in when the solution failed on this item. The trace then gets level ERROR.

experiment_id.label: Experiment ID
experiment_id.description: The experiment_id from 'Record experiment result'. Empty = derive it from dataset name and run name.

score_configs.label: Score configs
score_configs.description: Links every score to the score config with the same name in Langfuse. 'Require' makes the node fail when one is missing.

environment.label: Environment
environment.description: The Langfuse environment of the trace. The Langfuse SDK uses sdk-experiment.
